text:
Asha (Growth): Folks — our webinar landing + 3 launch posts need a final tech-SEO pass before we publish on Thurs. Main asks: keyword mapping, JSON-LD (Webinar + FAQ where useful), internal anchor plan, and tidy up legacy /events and /webinars redirects. Can we triage now?
Miguel R: I can own keywords and anchor text. Plan: 3 pillars per post (intent/short/long-tail) + SERP intent label. Will add to the shared sheet.
Chloe (Content): Drafts done for: landing, post1 (benchmark narrative), post2 (implementation deep-dive), post3 (webinar recap + CTAs). I'll add 160-char metas and OG tags. Do we want FAQ markup on recap?
Evan (Web): FAQ schema for recap is good. For landing and benchmark, use Webinar schema + breadcrumb + speakerevent. We'll inject JSON-LD in head for SSR pages. For SPA pages we should prerender the snippet. Example JSON-LD we plan to use:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","url":"https://redwood.ai"}}
```
seo-bot: Audit note: duplicate meta descriptions between landing and post1; missing H1 on post2. Will re-run after updates.
Asha (Growth): Redirects: we have old slugs under /events/serve-llms-2024 and /webinars/serve-llms. Prefer mass-301 to canonical landing, but preserve UTM/querystrings. Also watch for chains (old -> staging -> new).
Evan (Web): I'll implement an nginx rewrite that preserves querystring and sets 301. Example: `rewrite ^/events/(.*)$ /webinar/$1 permanent;` but better to use `return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/new-slug?$query_string;` I'll whitelist slugs to avoid accidental redirects.
Miguel R: Internal linking plan: landing should link to /product/inference (anchor: "LLM inference platform"), benchmark should link to /benchmarks ("inference benchmarks"), recap should link to /resources/webinars ("watch on-demand"). I'll add three anchor variants per destination.
Chloe (Content): Quick tag: OG image 1200x630 created and uploaded to CDN. Evan, can you add CDN invalidation request after deploy?
Evan (Web): Yep — will add invalidation to the deploy job. Also will set sitemap entries: priority 0.8, changefreq weekly, lastmod at publish. seo-bot: scheduled sitemap ping at 18:00 UTC.
Asha (Growth): Canonical policy: evergreen posts keep their own canonical. Only merge/301 duplicate splash pages to the landing. Chloe, mark duplicates in the spreadsheet column "redirect_action" (keep/301).
Miguel R: I'll annotate keyword intents (informational/commercial/transactional) and tag primary target for each post.
Chloe (Content): Adding example FAQ pairs for recap post: Q1 "How much does Redwood reduce token costs?" A: one-line summary + link to benchmark. Q2 "Can I run private deployments?" A: short answer + link.
Evan (Web): Also flag: AMP variants (if still live) must have rel=canonical to main page. I'll run a crawl to detect amp/html duplicates.
seo-bot: Preflight checklist: unique title tags, unique meta descriptions, single H1 per page, JSON-LD present for event/faq, internal links with descriptive anchor text, redirects 301 with no chains.
Asha (Growth): Owners and deadlines:
- Chloe: final drafts + metas + slug column (EOD today)
- Miguel: keyword buckets + anchor text (EOD today)
- Evan: redirects + JSON-LD placement + sitemap entries (tomorrow AM)
- seo-bot: final scan after staging deploy
If anything blocks the 10:00 PT content freeze ping me. Thanks!
